package choices

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type testServer struct{ calls int }

func (s *testServer) PostConfig(context.Context, *HttpsConfig) (*Coverage, error) {
	s.calls++
	return &Coverage{Choice: Maybe[CoverageChoiceOneof]{Value: CoverageChoiceOneof{}, Present: true}}, nil
}
func (s *testServer) PostAuditCollections(_ context.Context, x *AuditCollections) (*AuditCollections, error) {
	s.calls++
	return x, nil
}

func TestTransportValidation(t *testing.T) {
	handler := &testServer{}
	mux := CreateMux(handler, nil)
	bad := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/config", strings.NewReader(`{"cert_source":{}}`))
	bad.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(response, bad)
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || handler.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid request reached handler: %d, %d", response.Code, handler.calls)
	}
	good := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/config", nil)
	response = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(response, good)
	if response.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Fatalf("invalid response not rejected: %d", response.Code)
	}
	srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer srv.Close()
	client := NewConfigCapi(srv.URL)
	calls := handler.calls
	if _, err := client.PostConfig(context.Background(), &HttpsConfig{CertSource: Maybe[CertSource]{Value: CertSource{}, Present: true}}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("client accepted invalid request")
	}
	if handler.calls != calls {
		t.Fatal("invalid client request made HTTP call")
	}
}
